Name: FUWAMOCO Character and portrait
Author: ntpksr
Description:
1. Download and install "SMAPI" (Choose newest version)
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400

2. Download "Portraiture" (Choose newest version)
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999

3. Download "Content Patcher" (Choose newest version)
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915

4. Place the following files
Portraiture,
Content Patcher, 
[CP] Fuwawa,
[CP] Mococo
into the Mods folder.

5. Navigate to the Portraiture folder and then enter the Portraits folder. Place the Vtuber folder inside it.

6. Launch the game through SMAPI.

7.Enter the game and walk outside the house to find the character with the changed skin (when talking, you will notice that the portrait is still unchanged).

8. Minimize the game screen and open the SMAPI command prompt (the black screen similar to cmd).

9. Type "pmenu" and then open the game screen that has been minimized. You will be able to select Vtuber from the menu. Select it and you're done.

10. enjoy!
